app.title: Greenline
app.tagline: Compare crop rotations with NASA data

common.judgmentNote: Greenline supports your judgment and local experts. It doesn't replace them.
common.noField: Pick a field first to see this screen.

pick.title: Pick your field
pick.hint: Tap your field on the map. For now, any tap loads a sample field near Denton.
pick.mapOffline: The map needs an internet connection. You can still load the sample field.
pick.privacy: We store a 30 m map cell, never your exact location.

farm.title: Your farm
farm.currentRotation: What do you grow now? (tap in order)
farm.currentHint: Tap crops to add them in order. Tap a crop in your list to remove it.
farm.market: Where do you sell or use your crops?

story.title: Your field's story
story.bareHint: Brown squares are months with little or no plant cover (NDVI below 0.25).

compare.title: Compare rotations
compare.buildHint: Tap crops in order to build a rotation. It gets scored the same way.
compare.noCurrent: Add your current rotation on the Farm screen to compare it.

reasons.waterAvg: Average water need is {value} out of 5.
reasons.droughtHistory: Your field had {count} drought years since 2005.
reasons.erosionAvg: Soil protection is {value} out of 5 on average.
reasons.slopeBare: Your {slope}% slope makes bare seasons riskier.
reasons.nitrogen: {count} season(s) with a crop that adds nitrogen.
reasons.cashShare: {count} of {total} seasons have a crop you can sell.
reasons.forageAvg: Grazing and hay value is {value} out of 5.

gaps.budgetVariety: {count} different crops may be costly to start with a low budget.

risks.thirstyDryland: {crops} need a lot of water for dryland.
risks.heat: {crops} can suffer in heat. Your field had {count} hot or drought years.

confidence.longClimate: {count} years of climate data for your field.
confidence.goodHistory: {count} years of crop history from satellite maps.
confidence.familiarCrops: Most crops have been grown on this field before.
confidence.someNewCrops: Some crops are new to this field.
confidence.newCrops: Most crops are new to this field.
confidence.placeholderTraits: Crop trait values are early estimates and still being checked.

handoff.title: Summary for your county extension agent
handoff.intro: Bring or send this page to your local AgriLife extension office to talk through your options.
questions: Do these crops fit our local market and seed supply?
What planting dates and seeding rates work here?
Are there cost-share programs (like NRCS EQIP) for cover crops?
What risks am I missing for this field?

ndvi.title: NDVI (plant greenness)
ndvi.text: A satellite measure of how green and alive plants are, from 0 (bare) to 1 (very green). Placeholder text.

soilMoisture.title: Soil moisture anomaly
soilMoisture.text: How much wetter or drier the soil was than usual, from NASA's SMAP satellite. Placeholder text.

hydrologicGroup.title: Hydrologic group
hydrologicGroup.text: How fast water soaks into the soil. Group A soaks fastest, D slowest (more runoff). Placeholder text.

coverCrop.title: Cover crop
coverCrop.text: A crop grown mainly to protect and feed the soil between cash crops. Placeholder text.

slope.title: Slope
slope.text: How steep the field is. More slope means rain can wash soil away faster. From NASA SRTM. Placeholder text.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.text: How much data backs this score, and how familiar these crops are on your field. Placeholder text.

score.title: Score
score.text: A 0–100 summary of how well a rotation fits your priorities and limits. Each rule is open and editable. Placeholder text.

bareDays.title: Bare days
bareDays.text: Days when satellites saw little or no plant cover, so soil was exposed to wind and rain. Placeholder text.
